strings: Fifteen minutes is too long. Stripe retries at 1, 5 and 30 minutes, so a stuck claim blocks the second retry.
Sessions and thread side by side. The gate's three decisions are 52 and 48px targets, not desktop buttons scaled up.
The receipt says what ran, how long it took and that a checkpoint exists, in one card you can read at arm's length.
Changes, the diff and the plan arrive as a bottom sheet with a grab handle, because a right panel has nowhere to go here.
Off your network the route is Cloud, and the banner says the view lags rather than pretending it is live.
A tablet cannot be woken over a tailnet either, so pairing states the limit in the tablet's own words, before the first gate is missed.
